author: The Infographics Show
description:
In Alaska, people don’t just go missing, they vanish.

Across a vast, brutal stretch of wilderness known as the Alaska Triangle, thousands have disappeared without a trace. Planes go down, hikers never return, and even experienced adventurers seem to be swallowed by the landscape.
Some blame the weather, others point to predators, killers, magnetic anomalies, or something even stranger.

This deep dive into Something in Alaska is making people disappear explores the cases, the theories, and the terrifying reality of one of the most mysterious regions on Earth.

Because in Alaska, the wilderness doesn’t just hide secrets, It keeps them.
